'''Dali''' is a ''[[damane]]'' from [[Seanchan]]. Her sister [[Dani]] is also a ''damane''.

== Appearance ==
She is plump with yellow hair. 

== Activities ==
She is one of [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]]'s personal ''damane'' who is part of the [[Corenne]].

She is one of the ''damane'' who is sent to the [[Battle of Tar Valon]].
